principle.qualityRule: No example is better than a mediocre example that models can cargo-cult.
principle.literalValuesAre: specimen evidence, not reusable truth unless the same product/system constraints justify them

craftCoreSkills.teachingJob: task hierarchy -> scene hierarchy -> native Figma structure -> rendered craft -> reusable truth
semantic field pressure -> layout owner -> sizing contract -> stress -> re-entry
semantic relation -> plane/input relation -> silhouette/cue economy -> prototype handoff
system role -> occupied area/repetition/backdrop -> perceptual composition -> reusable mapping
information role -> type mass/metrics -> text-slot pressure -> geometry -> rendered hierarchy

behavioralCases.prompt: Polish a compact observability companion where Connection, Requests, Activity, Diagnostics, and a live log are currently presented as equally weighted cards. Product behavior is already approved; do not invent features.
expectedDelta: reconstruct task hierarchy before styling
avoid equal-card inventory treatment
choose bounded detail drill-down instead of permanent diagnostics region
render/critique whole-scene craft rather than stop at valid structure
preserve native reusable Figma ownership
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Returns a cleaner card dashboard without changing the causal scene hierarchy or without rendered critique.

behavioralCases.prompt: Repair a request log that looks correct at 420px but loses latency/status with long Vietnamese labels and shows only two rows on a short viewport.
expectedDelta: assign bounded/flexible field ownership from scan semantics
preserve log as the vertical FILL working region
stress long labels, numeric width, narrow width, and short height
avoid global font shrinking or stack-everything fallback
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Tweaks spacing/font size locally without naming the row/viewport invariant or pressure owner.

behavioralCases.prompt: Add request drill-down to a compact companion while preserving the user’s place in a live log. A permanent diagnostics panel and an inline-expanded row are both possible.
expectedDelta: separate semantic containment from plane/input priority
compare inline, persistent inspector, navigation, and transient overlay forms
use minimum sufficient scrim/overlap/silhouette/elevation cues
define dismissal/focus recovery when prototype behavior is material
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Chooses bottom sheet by pattern memory without explaining why the compact focus/persistence relation earns it, or only changes z-order/shadow.

behavioralCases.prompt: A token-correct operational UI uses green, blue, amber, and purple fills across most cards/rows and feels noisy. Improve it without deleting semantic distinctions.
expectedDelta: separate semantic role from occupied chroma/repetition/backdrop
reduce normal-state chroma mass while keeping category/exception scan cues
solve base surface hierarchy before adding shadows/new tokens
verify the composition at real occupied area
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Mints more color tokens or merely desaturates every value without reasoning about area, repetition, and plane role.

behavioralCases.prompt: A dense operational screen is readable and spacing-compliant but still feels crowded because nearly every heading, row label, status, and metric is semibold. Improve hierarchy without simply adding whitespace.
expectedDelta: diagnose whole-scene repeated type mass
map information roles before changing metrics
use weight/size/spacing/color together rather than weight alone
stress numeric alignment, Vietnamese labels, and font metrics
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Adds padding or shrinks type globally without tracing information role -> style -> slot -> layout pressure.

behavioralCases.prompt: Build a reusable Toggle with Off/On/Disabled state vocabulary, then add one consumer that needs product-specific same-trigger behavior and a Card Actions Slot constrained to at most two approved actions.
expectedDelta: separate component state vocabulary from prototype transition graph
preserve full component-property API keys instead of reconstructing visible labels
use SlotSettings/limitViolations for bounded flexible content rather than variant explosion
prove representative instances and propagation without detach
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Produces visually correct components but duplicates screen wiring, reconstructs property keys, ignores Slot violations, or calls a detached/local copy reusable proof.

behavioralCases.prompt: Wire an interactive Toggle whose variants inherit click Change-to behavior, then add a single instance click that opens confirmation; also trace cancel/recovery and state result.
expectedDelta: model same-trigger inherited-vs-instance precedence explicitly
trace primary and cancel/recovery paths from exact source IDs
keep product-specific confirmation outside the reusable component behavior
avoid claiming production accessibility/keyboard/AT proof from Figma prototype evidence
behavioralCases.failureSignal: Assumes both same-trigger reactions compose, duplicates the reusable graph locally, omits recovery, or upgrades prototype interaction evidence into production accessibility PASS.

behavioralCoreEvidence.rule: Behavioral-component teaching cases may guide the agent after method review, but they do not prove Figma runtime behavior until representative executions are run.

behavioralCoreSkills.teachingJob: semantic job -> anatomy/property/slot/state API -> representative consumers -> propagation/migration proof
approved state truth -> trigger/action/condition/context/recovery -> precedence/readback proof
